evidence.name: Screen field: How thick the empty track is
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How thick the empty track is" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How thick the empty track is
sections.description: Height of the background track in pixels (0-50, default 4px). Keep it equal to the fill thickness for a standard flat bar — the safe choice for most screens. Make it larger than the fill only if you want a recessed groove look, since mismatched values change how the fill sits inside the track.
